{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk sheath dress, straight cut, floor-length, deep burgundy (#4a0e15), satin weave.
Pointed-toe pumps, narrow silhouette, mid-calf height, metallic gold (#d4af37), smooth leather.
Dangling crystals earrings, teardrop shape, medium length, champagne color (#f7e7ce), rhinestone setting.
This ensemble strikes the perfect balance for a 19:00 restaurant banquet by combining the elegance of noble silk with the warmth of autumn tones. The floor-length cut and rich burgundy hue convey the necessary formality while the gold heels add a celebratory sparkle suitable for an evening occasion. Avoiding heavy outer layers, the lightweight satin ensures comfort throughout the event without compromising on style."}
